thread_text:
1. Why Mythos now?

Elon Musk just backed a new AI contender, shifting the public spotlight away from OpenAI.

2. Fable AI gets praise

Musk publicly praised Fable AI and promised it protection, signaling a strategic alliance.

3. Musk won't cut Anthropic

He also committed to not cutting off Anthropic's funding, keeping multiple horses in the race.

4. Bet on both sides

Take a prompt you use daily and run it on ChatGPT, then on Fable AI. Compare outputs blindly.

instagram.caption:
Elon Musk just gave his public backing to a new AI model called Fable (from Mythos) and promised he won’t cut off funding for Anthropic either. 🧵

That means he’s now openly backing three competing AI companies—OpenAI, Anthropic, and Fable—simultaneously. His praise and protection signal a strategic bet on multiple horses, not just one.

For anyone creating content or publishing, this means the AI race has a new wildcard. Which model you pick for your workflow might flip based on Musk’s next move. 📉
